profiling.finding: The thumbnail sidebar used the default nonvirtualizing StackPanel. It constructed and arranged 20000 thumbnail control trees, then detached them synchronously on a session DataContext change. The continuous PDF viewer already used a VirtualizingStackPanel.
profiling.change: Use VirtualizingStackPanel for ThumbnailsItemsControl; keep existing thumbnail image loading, eviction, commands, bindings and continuous-page scheduling.

newRegressions: 20000 placeholders keep realized controls bounded while scrolling to the last page, editing its checkbox and rebinding between documents
Real sidebar recycling loads the newly visible thumbnail and still evicts distant thumbnail images

limits: Native tests drive the real view model/workspace in process, not physical mouse or keyboard input.
